request.spec:
A steward can clone the sheet to another id (an entry and a button; SHEET_CLONE_MADE to=<id> on this
sheet). The other sheet must be empty (never used); otherwise, or for anyone but a steward, the
clone is refused with an error on the sheet. The clone gets this sheet's today, settings, roles,
rates, holidays, void reasons, templates, people (grades, terms, contacts, aliases, tags, holds,
retirements, patrons), pools, periods (all open) and claims (status, frozen figures, dates, notes,
logs; numbers given afresh in the order the originals were opened (by the sheet's today when each
was opened, then by the order they were added), by the clone's own numbering); statements are not
copied. The clone's first audit line is SHEET_CLONED from=<this sheet's id>, followed by its rollup
lines for every person and its totals.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A steward can clone the sheet to another id (an entry and a button; SHEET_CLONE_MADE to=<id> on this
sheet). The other sheet must be empty (never used); otherwise, or for anyone but a steward, the
clone is refused with an error on the sheet. The clone gets this sheet's today, settings, roles,
rates, holidays, void reasons, templates, people (grades, terms, contacts, aliases, tags, holds,
retirements, patrons), pools, periods (all open) and claims (status, frozen figures, dates, notes,
logs; numbers given afresh in the order the originals were opened (by the sheet's today when each
was opened, then by the order they were added), by the clone's own numbering); statements are not
copied. The clone's first audit line is SHEET_CLONED from=<this sheet's id>, followed by its rollup
lines for every person and its totals.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
I've added sheet cloning, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests, including the clone test.

**How it works**
- **Screen:** the sheet panel now has a `sheet-clone-to` entry, a `sheet-clone` button and a `sheet-cloned-to` field showing the last clone made. The field clears when the button is pressed. A refused clone shows the existing `sheet-error`. There can only be one `sheet-error` on the page or the test can't read it, so the clone controls sit in the same component (`features/sheet/today.slot.tsx`).
- **Server:** a new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/clone`, refuses anyone but a steward, and refuses any target id that has ever been used. A refused clone writes nothing to the store or the audit file.
- **Audit:** this sheet gets `SHEET_CLONE_MADE to=<id>`. The clone's first lines are `SHEET_CLONED from=<id>`, then a ROLLUP line for every person and a TOTALS line.
- **Model:** I based it on the existing transfer-person feature. A new `SheetCloneRepository` copies everything except claims; the claim copying is two new methods in `ClaimRepository`.

**Claim numbering:** each person's claims are copied in list order, oldest first. Numbers are then given by the sheet's today when each claim was opened, then by the order the claims were added to the clone. The test needs that last part: it expects Ada 1, Ben 2 and 3, Cam 4, even though Cam's claim was created first on the original sheet. Corrections and splits point to the new numbers.

**Choices the request left open — say if you want any changed:**
- **Parent sheet:** copied, because it is set through the settings form.
- **Claims:** copied with their status, settled figure, dates, terms, notes, logs, proofs, void reason and who opened and edited them. Tags, comments, external references and settle batches are not copied, because the request's list leaves them out (the transfer feature does carry tags and comments).
- **Not copied:** statements and the figures they bound, closed or soft-closed period state, delegations, watches and people merged into others. The archived flag is not copied either.
- **Archived sheets:** a steward can still clone one. The request only names the two refusal reasons (not a steward, target id already used), so I didn't add a third.
- **"As of" history:** the clone's history starts on its own today. Viewing the clone as of an earlier date won't show the original sheet's past.
